title: A Multicenter, Double-Blind, Phase 3 Study of the Efficacy and Safety of Anifrolumab in Myositis: Rationale and Design of the JASMINE Trial.
snippet: Idiopathic inflammatory myopathies (IIM) including dermatomyositis (DM) and polymyositis (PM) are a part of a larger group of rare multisystem autoimmune rheumatic disorders.
